creation_paths: HTTP POST /api/agents via legacy adapter to AgentProvisioning
findings: AgentProvisioning is already the sole persistent creation authority; the legacy Creator is an oversized transport adapter and compatibility health name.
No primary identity/profile/conversation binding exists and no agent kind is explicit.
Swarm accepts pre-existing member IDs but has no resource-aware dynamic workforce planner or ephemeral lifecycle.
Workers and TaskAttempts already provide separate executor and execution-history concepts suitable for association, not replacement.
Existing human-editable agent directories are concrete workspace data, not a reusable template catalog, and no primary may be inferred from their names.
The requested primary and ephemeral stores are authorized additions to the existing Storage Primitive, while CONFIG/SOUL/SKILLS remain outside it.
